dict.string: Notch Island reads what Music or Spotify is playing and controls playback, and its Dark Mode switch asks System Events to change the appearance.
Notch Island shows a short notice when AirPods or other Bluetooth devices connect.
Notch Island shows your week's events and counts down to your next meeting.
Notch Island's mirror shows your camera so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded.
Notch Island shows files that are still downloading, if you turn that on.
All Set uses the microphone only while you record the screen with microphone audio turned on.
Desk Minder adds your reminders to Apple Reminders so they also alert on your iPhone and other devices.
